# Obsidian Syntax

A link to [[Another Note]] and one with an alias, [[Another Note|see here]].

A link into a heading: [[Another Note#Some Section]].

With a 's' in the group execute position.
![[Pasted image 01.png]]

Before the picture.
![[diagram.png|300]]
After the picture.

An embed ![[inline.png]] inside a sentence stays as text.

Ordinary markdown still works: [a link](https://example.com) and
![an image](pic.png).
